indicator.subject: Mathematics
indicator.content_standard: B4.3.3.3 Demonstrate understanding of time taken by events in minutes and hours
indicator.objective: State dates of events and record calendar dates in a variety of formats

skills.description: Write dates in different formats (e.g., 28th August, 2018; 28-Aug-18; 28/08/2018).
Identify dates of national events from a calendar.

spec.difficultyPlan: 20 questions: 5 at difficulty 1, 7 at difficulty 2, 5 at difficulty 3, 3 at difficulty 4.
misconceptions: Mixing up month and day in slash format.

questions.stem: Which of these is a correct way to write the date 6th March 2023?
hints: 6th is the day, 3rd month is March.

questions.stem: On which date does Ghana celebrate Independence Day?
Write '15th May 2021' in the format DD/MM/YYYY.
Which month is represented by the number 12 in a date?
hints: The last month of the year.

questions.stem: Write 01/01/2024 in words (e.g., 1st January 2024).
questions.misconception: Writing 1st January 2024? That's correct. Let me rephrase to test month order. 'Write 03/04/2023 in words'.

questions.stem: Which date format is written correctly?
hints: Look at the standard DD-MMM-YY format.

questions.stem: Ghana's Republic Day is celebrated on which date?
hints: It marks the transition to a republic.
It is in the middle of the year.

questions.stem: In the date 14/02/2022, what is the month number?
Name the month with 28 or 29 days.
Convert the date 05/09/2024 to the format 'Day Month Year' (e.g., 5th September 2024).
Farmers' Day in Ghana is celebrated on the first Friday of which month?
hints: It is at the end of the year.

questions.stem: Write the date 31/12/1999 in the DD-MMM-YY format.
Explain the difference between DD/MM/YYYY and MM/DD/YYYY formats.
questions.explanation: DD/MM/YYYY puts the day first, then the month. MM/DD/YYYY puts the month first, then the day. For example, 05/06/2023 is 5th June in DD/MM, but 6th May in MM/DD.

questions.stem: How many days are there in the month of June?
hints: 30 days has September, April, June, and November.

questions.stem: A pupil's birthday is on 29/02/2024. Why is this date special?
options: It is a leap year date.
hints: This is called a leap year.
questions.explanation: 29th February only exists in a leap year.

questions.stem: A document uses the format YYYY-MM-DD. Write the date 4th October 2023 in this format.
Which of these months has exactly 31 days?
hints: 30 days has September, April, June, and November.

questions.stem: A pupil is 10 years old. If their birthday is on 1st January 2014, what is the current year? (Assume they just had their birthday)
hints: Add their age to the birth year.

questions.stem: A student writes a date as 11/12/2022 and another writes 12/11/2022. Could they be writing the same date? Explain.
questions.explanation: No, they represent different dates. 11/12 in DD/MM is 11th December, while 12/11 is 12th November. Unless they are using different formats and referring to the same day, the numbers swapped indicate different dates.

criteria.description: Concludes they are likely different dates.

questions.misconception: Thinking the numbers can be freely swapped.

questions.stem: A festival is held on the last Friday of September. If September 1st is a Monday, what date is the festival?
questions.explanation: The Fridays are 5, 12, 19, 26. The last one is 26th September.
questions.misconception: Choosing 30th because it's the last day.
